scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']){try{fs.unlinkSync(f)}catch{}}const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm')){console.error('This project is managed with pnpm.
